subject: [NAME] Invite: Physical AI Panel - SF, 01/29
text:
H [NAME],

Really interested in what you're building at [COMPANY] and right
up our avenue with the work we do with 1X, Agility Robotics, Dyna and
Boston Dynamics.

Wanted to invite you to a Physical AI panel in SF, featuring Chris Paxton
(AI Lead at Agility Robotics) and moderated by Chris Paulson (Senior
Robotics DevRel at NVIDIA).

The event will take place from 5:30pm on Thursday 29th Jan at Weights &
Biases's office in SF, with panelists from leading robotics teams, e.g. 1X
and Dyna Robotics and more, followed by an informal networking session
after.

The discussion will centre around the impact of recent developments (e.g.
VLM/VLA, UMI, World Models, etc) as well first-hand perspectives on
training and validating models in the physical world.

Full details on the panel here
<[LINK]>
- let me know if you can join us?

subject: [NAME] - CES follow up
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope you had a great week at CES! I wanted to personally reach out while we
weren't able to connect over our dinner.

I'd still love to grab a quick virtual coffee and hear more about Ventify's
data and ML pipeline. My team at Encord has been supporting AI teams
handling complex, multimodal, high-stakes datasets, helping them scale
annotation, QA, and model iteration efficiently.

Would you be open to a quick 20-min next week for a brief chat? Happy to
work around your schedule.

subject: [NAME] - QA & edge cases
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope you're well! Spoke with Taleb last year - what stuck with me was the
challenge of edge cases and QA at ~60% initial label accuracy.

At Encord, we've helped IDV teams like Entrust/Onfido, Veridd, and VIDA
automate QA workflows and active learning loops - giving teams better
visibility into what's breaking, where models need retraining, and speeding
up iteration while saving engineering effort.

Would it make sense to connect for a quick 20-min chat? We can show how the
platform could fit into your current stack and workflow and how others are
leveraging it.

Tue-Thu usually works well for me - happy to fit your schedule.
